SleekDemo 2.4.0

Change what's behind you, style presets, music, and an important fix.

  • Behind You: blur your room, use a clean studio backdrop, or remove it and leave just you.
  • Style presets: save your look, apply it in one click, and use it for new recordings.
  • Music: a track under your video that fades and dips while you talk.
  • Private crash reports you choose to send.
  • Fix: a crash in vertical videos with Fill, or with the MacBook frame.

SleekDemo 2.3.1

Vertical videos that fill the frame, and a fixed keystroke display.

  • Fill Vertical Frame: your screen fills vertical videos and follows your pointer.
  • Zooms always fill the frame: no background or MacBook frame around a zoomed screen.
  • Captions for phones: bigger in vertical videos, above the strip phone apps cover.
  • Fixes: the keystroke display is upright, and new recordings show shortcuts only.

SleekDemo 2.3.0

A MacBook Pro frame, camera layouts that look right in every format, and a calmer editor.

  • MacBook Pro frame in Silver or Space Black (Style › Frame).
  • Side by side, redesigned: your whole screen and a natural camera card, centred; stacked in square and vertical videos.
  • Smoother layout changes: the camera grows out of its bubble and the screen glides into place.
  • Fixes: the editor no longer jumps when you click in the sidebar; exports can't overwrite your original; trimming keeps your cuts; recording reports a full disk right away and keeps camera footage.
